scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.note: no input at all: the baseline that must produce zero corrections

scenarios.name: turns
scenarios.note: four legal turns at ticks 1,3,5,7 (queue depth 4)

scenarios.name: illegal
scenarios.note: duplicate then 180-degree reversal then a legal turn

scenarios.name: wrap
scenarios.note: straight ahead until both edges wrap

scenarios.name: tight_turns
scenarios.note: four turns inside four ticks (a fast mobile swipe burst)

scenarios.name: self_collision
scenarios.note: head enters own body: deterministic, but death stays server-owned

scenarios.name: food
scenarios.note: known food ahead: growth predictable, respawn and score are not

scenarios.name: freeze
scenarios.note: authoritative freeze then resume; a frozen snake never advances

scenarios.name: eliminated
scenarios.note: server eliminates mid-round: prediction must stop, not replay

scenarios.name: latency_0ms
scenarios.note: same four turns, 0 tick uplink, 0 ms downlink

scenarios.name: latency_100ms
scenarios.note: same four turns, 1 tick uplink, 100 ms downlink

scenarios.name: latency_200ms
scenarios.note: same four turns, 2 tick uplink, 200 ms downlink

scenarios.name: latency_300ms
scenarios.note: same four turns, 3 tick uplink, 300 ms downlink

scenarios.name: latency_260ms_jitter
scenarios.note: same four turns, 2 tick uplink, 260 ms downlink
